research.title: Image Classification Robustness Under Lighting Variation
bullets: Designed experiments with supervisor guidance to compare brightness augmentation and contrast normalization for convolutional image classifiers under simulated lighting changes.
Evaluated clean and transformed image splits, examining classwise errors and confidence distributions to distinguish robustness changes from baseline classification differences.

research.title: Boundary Evaluation for Foreground Segmentation
bullets: Planned supervised comparisons of segmentation losses with supervisor guidance, holding training splits and preprocessing constant while varying boundary weighting.
Implemented evaluation routines for mask overlap and boundary agreement, then inspected predictions around thin structures and low contrast object edges.

work.title: Inventory and Order Documentation Support
bullets: Checked incoming deliveries against packing slips, recorded discrepancies, and routed incomplete shipment documentation to the appropriate staff for follow-up.
Organized order paperwork, updated routine inventory records, and prepared handover notes identifying unresolved stock discrepancies and pending delivery confirmations.

projects.title: Comparing Feature Representations for Image Classification
bullets: Implemented histogram of oriented gradients features with a linear classifier and compared them against a convolutional classifier using shared image splits.
Evaluated classification accuracy and confusion patterns, examining how grayscale conversion and image resizing affected errors across visually similar categories.

projects.title: Classical Edge Detection Under Image Noise
bullets: Implemented Sobel and Canny edge detection pipelines, comparing their responses to Gaussian noise and blur on a shared image collection.
Compared detected edges against reference contours using precision and recall, and inspected how smoothing settings changed edge continuity and spurious responses.
